pages.title: Equipment
pages.text: Some zombies emerge from darkness already wearing armor. I have never seen them mine or forge, yet their armor is as real as mine.

pages.title: Putting It to Work
pages.text: Use the tuner on the device, then a nearby $(l)armor stand$(). It consumes the stand’s armor one piece at a time. Worn pieces yield less; enchantments do not increase the yield.
